manual_reasoning_checks: Unit and period contract is explicit: one year, kCU, one entity, no hidden accounts, no FX/acquisitions/deferred tax. Interest classification and20% current-tax rule are stipulated teaching conventions. Correcting book/tax expense does not change observed tax cash16.

Reconciled all baseline accounts: opening600; draft assets724=liabilities362+equity362; reported NI112,CFO64,CFI-60,CFF-30,closing cash54. Direct customer/supplier/operating cash agrees independently with indirect profit adjustments.

Service correction has supplied unperformed/no-right/no-payment/no-cost-release facts. Reverse revenue/AR40 and current tax/payable8; NI/equity fall32. Corrected assets684=liabilities354+equity330. The CFO changes-32+40-8 cancel. Error correction does not identify intent.

Contract algebra uses actual stated definitions, positive denominator, eligible cash, cap10, ratio limit1 and cash minimum40. Corrected net debt176 exceeds covenant EBITDA170. Numerator headroom-6 is not automatically repaired by debt repayment funded from existing cash; the cash source and date matter.

Financing scenarios change both cash and debt/equity consistently. Restricted cash10 reduces eligibility without disappearing from balance-sheet cash. Separate minimum cash can fail even with unchanged net-debt leverage. Hypothetical actions must occur before measurement; no implied retrospective cure or automatic acceleration.

Normalization reconciles management245 to corrected accounting160, symmetric recurring165 and separately contractual170. Recurring marketing25 stays. Removing favorable settlement15 has the opposite sign to adding back severance20; a recurring severance estimate5 changes normalized EBITDA to160.

Unit economics supplies a conditional constant-cost/capacity range;4.5 contribution and195 fixed recurring cash imply130/3 continuous installations,44 whole installations. Neither operating EBITDA break-even nor noncash depreciation eliminates maintenance investment, financing or working-capital needs.

Growth example has independent direct/indirect and balance-sheet closure: incremental NI67.2,CFO13.2,investment30,cash-16.8,net assets85.2=AP18+equity67.2. Slower collection changes cash but not stipulated recognition; an annual delta is not a complete next-year cash calendar.
Capitalized repair15 correction reduces EBITDA/EBIT15,tax/payable3,NI/equity12,PPE15; CFO falls15 and CFI improves15 while total cash stays54. Both accounts and covenant headroom are recalculated.

Read and solved every prompt against its answer. The allowance exercise explicitly offers either net-receivable movement or gross movement plus noncash add-back, avoiding double counting. Cohort collection supports settlement but not year-end performance or remaining collectibility. Open memo has concrete fact and reasoning criteria.

All source claims are scoped to the actual inspected bodies. No audit assurance, fraud classification, authenticated-document claim, full standards compliance or guaranteed business outcome is asserted.

findings.finding: The broad statement that all operating costs except depreciation settle in cash could obscure inventory/COGS and trade-payable timing.
findings.resolution: Narrowed to other operating expenses, with explicit inventory-purchase/payables roll-forward and separate tax-payment lag. No figures or computational model changed.

limitations: Synthetic accounting identities and stipulated recognition/tax/contract facts; no authenticated external evidence, legal conclusion or fraud detection.
Annual cash and covenant gates do not establish intra-year solvency or authorize a retroactive cure.
Source inspection is scoped, not full current reporting/audit compliance certification.
Browser, mobile and print visual QA not performed.
The benchmark deliberately excludes current-tax receivables/refunds/loss regimes and rejects those edits rather than silently applying an invented rule.
The growth module is incremental to a specified comparator, not a full second-year entity forecast. Funding needed to retain comparator cash may differ from peak dated liquidity need.
Qualitative evidence_facts strings describe the original case; scalar interventions are explicitly hypothetical changes in facts and cannot override real transaction evidence.
Author review does not replace separate coordinator/peer review; acceptance requires the preceding chapter.
